Client Name
6 July 2026
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for taking the time to connect with us about your organisation. We really appreciate the opportunity to put this together and we are genuinely excited about what we can create.

From what we understand about your organisation, there is a genuine story here worth sharing. The work you do deserves production values that reflect it properly, and that is something we take seriously on every project.

This proposal outlines our approach to producing a video that captures what makes your organisation worth watching. We have put together a scope that we think hits the right notes, and we are always open to refining it based on what you need.

If you have any questions at all, please do not hesitate to reach out. We would love to chat through the details over a coffee if that works for you.

Kind regards, Patrick Wood Director | Tempus Media

We areTEMPUS MEDIA

We are your Brisbane based Video Production and Photography Specialists. We have doubled-down on what we're good at — making stuff! We step you through the entire process; from the time-consuming pre-production (script development / brand discovery), production (shoot) all the way through to the post-production (editing).

With a team of 6 (plus Office Dog Kodi), we're small but mighty! As young, personable, meme-loving and tech-savvy people — you're in good hands.

    OurCLIENTS

    We are proud to work alongside some of Australia's most respected brands and institutions. These are long-term partnerships built on trust, great content, and a shared commitment to telling stories that actually land.

    We are regularly contracted to Tennis Australia and are their Brisbane based video production studio for when they need content shot and edited. Working with athletes is a run and gun video style that can take some practice.
    We shoot approximately 50 videos for Torrens University Australia each year. These are mainly piece to camera interview style. This type of corporate content is something we specialise in.
